verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation of pipeline-based revenue forecasting that uses stage probabilities and close dates. Zia's custom predictions of a deal's win likelihood or expected revenue are an AI scoring feature, not weighted pipeline forecasting. COQL, the APIs and report creation are building blocks a developer could use to construct a forecast, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates
